_help: Edit this file to update the roadmap on docs/projects/whats-next.html. 'status' must be one of the ids in 'statuses'. Only mark an item 'released' when it is in the app people can use today. Items appear under 'Available now' (released) or 'Coming up' (everything else).
reviewedAgainst: What-Next README (v2.1.1), build-apk.yml and capacitor.config.json. Individual features were not re-tested against the app's source files.
note: Planned, in-progress and testing items will be added here as they are confirmed. Nothing is listed as coming soon until it is real.

statuses.label: Testing
statuses.description: Built and being checked before release

areas.title: Discovery
areas.description: Finding something to watch or read next.

items.title: Pick for me
items.description: Choose Watch, Read or Either and how much time you have (15 minutes to 2 hours) to get a suggestion from your Watching, Reading, Repeating and Planning lists.

items.title: Discover tab
items.description: Search AniList for new anime or manga by type, genre, sort order (Trending, Popular, Top rated, Newest) and title. Titles already on your list are marked.

items.title: Trending carousels
items.description: Trending anime and manga on the Pick screen.

items.title: Genre and 18+ filters
items.description: Genre chips built from your own list, plus show everything, only 18+ or hide 18+ titles.

areas.title: AniList integration
areas.description: Using your AniList account and AniList's data.

items.title: AniList login
items.description: Log in with your AniList account on the web and in the Android app. There is no guest mode.

items.title: Media pages
items.description: Score, genres, synopsis, characters, staff, relations, recommendations and where to watch for any title.

items.title: Character, staff and studio pages
items.description: Dedicated pages with favourites, voice actors, roles and related media.

items.title: Chat
items.description: One-to-one private messages with other AniList users, using AniList's own message system.

items.title: Discord sync
items.description: Anime and manga updates from your AniList list posted to Discord forum threads, run from inside the app.

areas.title: List management
areas.description: Browsing and updating your anime and manga lists.

items.title: Anime and manga lists
items.description: Status tabs, search, a filter sheet (sort, format, status, country, year, length, score, genres) and grid/list customisation.

items.title: List editor
items.description: Status, progress, score, dates, rewatches, priority, custom lists, notes, private and favourite flags, and remove.

items.title: Progress tracking
items.description: +1 / -1 progress and Mark as done save to AniList, with consistent status and date rules everywhere.

areas.title: Usability
areas.description: Making the app comfortable to use every day.

items.title: Stats and daily goal
items.description: Backlog hours, top genres, titles finished this month, and a daily goal with a streak.

items.title: Airing schedule
items.description: A countdown to the next episode of every airing anime on your list.

items.title: Appearance and privacy options
items.description: System, Light, Dark, AMOLED or custom colours, plus a Blur covers option for use in public.

items.title: Offline mode
items.description: Installs to your home screen and shows your last saved list without a connection. Changes made offline are kept on the device and sent when you are back online.

items.title: Automated tests
items.description: Structure checks, tracking-rule unit tests and real-browser tests run by a GitHub Actions workflow on every push.

areas.title: Android releases
areas.description: Getting the app onto Android phones.

items.title: Android APK builds
items.description: An Android app (package com.whatnext.app) with AniList login returning to the app. APKs are currently built as debug/testing builds and published through GitHub releases.
